audit_phase: Phase J — Citation Validity & Provenance Metrics

definitions.citation_validity_rate: Ratio of cited chunk IDs that exist in the authoritative PostgreSQL chunks table.
definitions.metadata_completeness_rate: Ratio of citations with non-empty chunk_id, document_id, document_title, and excerpt.
definitions.evidence_quote_alignment_rate: Ratio of citation excerpts that appear verbatim in the cited chunk text.
